_comment: Preset replies the TV can send. The TV only ever sends the id; the text below is what Claude receives. Edit freely (max 6 per group).

turn.label: Push & Commit to Dev
turn.text: Commit all current changes with a clear message and push them to the dev branch (create it from the current branch if it doesn't exist). Do not deploy to production and do not merge into main.

turn.label: Wait
turn.text: Wait — don't make any further changes until I'm back at my desk. Just summarise where things stand.

turn.label: No
turn.text: No, don't do that. Stop here and briefly summarise the current state.
